jobs.name: su2-f3-stage1-n070
container_setup: apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends build-essential python3 python3-venv python3-pip git pkg-config ca-certificates openmpi-bin libopenmpi-dev libgl1 libglu1-mesa libxrender1 libxcursor1 libxfixes3 libxft2 libfontconfig1 libxinerama1
jobs.command:
set -e
export PATH=/opt/venv/bin:/opt/su2/bin:$PATH SU2_RUN=/opt/su2/bin SU2_HOME=/opt/SU2-src
export OMPI_MCA_osc=^ucx OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
git rev-parse HEAD > "$GTU_OUT/commit.txt"
rc=0
python3 routes/gtu/frame3/frame3_geom.py --out "$GTU_OUT/geom" --levels medium --stages stage1 --gzip-levels --threads "$NPROC" --results "$GTU_OUT/frame3_geom_results.json"
python3 routes/gtu/platform/su2/su2_case.py run --geom-results "$GTU_OUT/frame3_geom_results.json" --stage stage1 --level medium --point routes/gtu/frame3/frame3_point_results.json:stage1 --speed 0.7 --points 0.45:2500,0.52:1500,0.58:1500,0.64:1500,0.7:1500,0.76:1500,0.83:1500,0.9:1500 --iter-scale 2 --shroud slip --vaneless slip --np "$NPROC" --mpi-args "" --time-limit 38261 --output-files RESTART --out "$GTU_OUT/run" --record "$GTU_OUT/su2_line.json" || rc=$?
# сетки (сотни МБ) не выгружаются: их заново строит frame3_geom.py по коммиту
rm -f "$GTU_OUT/run/mesh.su2" "$GTU_OUT/run/mesh_split.su2" "$GTU_OUT"/geom/*/passage_custom_*.su2
exit "$rc"
